subject: EcoPeps daily: 10 shipped, 2 decisions waiting
preheader: 10 things shipped, 2 decisions waiting on you, 4 tasks lined up for tomorrow.
title: November 11, 2026
summary: The biggest day this week. Staff pages are locked down, customers can now track orders and edit their accounts, and the store no longer depends on a single payment processor.

decisions.question: Delist EP-GLP3-R from the shop: merge or close?
decisions.context: The change is written and sitting as a draft. Nothing happens until you pick one.

decisions.question: Crypto and ACH payments: bring back or remove?
decisions.context: Both are switched off and refused by the server. The code is still in the site.

items.text: Set up two-step sign-in on the support@ecopeps.com staff account
items.note: Staff pages show only the setup screen until this is done.

items.text: Update the “Change email address” template in Supabase
items.note: Until then, customers can’t finish changing their email.

items.text: Confirm the account-details database change is live
Place one real card order end to end on the live site
items.note: Stripe shows no live payments yet.

items.title: Staff pages now check for staff before loading anything
items.why: A signed-in customer could previously receive order data on a “not found” page.

items.title: Two-step sign-in for staff pages
items.why: Matches the promise in the Privacy Policy.

items.title: Switched-off payment methods are refused by the server
items.why: Crypto and ACH were hidden at checkout but still reachable directly.

items.title: My Orders page and a “Your order has shipped” email
items.why: Customers see status, items and a tracking link.

items.title: Customers can edit their details, email and password
items.why: No more support requests for simple account changes.

items.title: Orders-to-ship and back-in-stock pages
items.why: Mark an order shipped and email the buyer in one click.

items.title: 5 p.m. daily and Monday weekly activity summaries
items.why: Orders, new accounts and traffic, emailed to support.

items.title: New-account alerts and page-view tracking
items.why: See who signed up and what they looked at.

items.title: Payments no longer tied to one processor
items.why: Order emails now come from EcoPeps whichever processor takes the payment.

items.title: 68 automated tests run on every change
items.why: Problems are caught before they reach the live site.

inProgress.text: Daily and weekly progress reports: generator and backlog ready, test emails going out.

health.label: Live site
health.value: Up. Latest deploy ready at 1:42 p.m. MT
